اعصوصبن (form XII)
# اِعْصَوْصَبْنَ (iʕṣawṣabna) /iʕ.sˤaw.sˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# اِعْصَوْصِبْنَ (iʕṣawṣibna) /iʕ.sˤaw.sˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
